Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1996
ACT II OF 1996
SINDH FINANCE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Sindh Finance Act, 1964
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd January, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-23/95.----The
Sindh Finance (Second Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 18th December, 1995 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 8th January, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Finance (Second Amendment) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of West Pakistan Act XXIV of 1964

ACT II OF 1996
ACT II OF 1996
SINDH FINANCE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Sindh Finance Act, 1964
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd January, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-23/95.----The
Sindh Finance (Second Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 18th December, 1995 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 8th January, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of West Pakistan Act XXIV of 1964.--- In the Sindh
Finance Act, 1964, in the fifth Schedule, in serial No.2, in Column No. 1, the
words "industrial undertakings" and in Column No.2, the words
"one and a half paisa per unit of energy" shall be deleted.

Repeal of Sindh Ordinance IX of 1995

3. Repeal of Sindh Ordinance IX of 1995.---The Sindh Finance
(Second Amendment) Ordinance 1995 is hereby repealed.
